answers.answer: The legacy reconciliation stack is consolidated with private DM report slices: invitation shortlist with historical exclusion and company caps, inbox evidence with CREATE-to-INBOX correlation, a DM action planner with manual reply/follow-up/first-DM queues, and three-doc publication to owner-only Google Docs for connections, first-time DMs and follow-ups through one marker-safe, revision-checked publisher with dual preflight and retained-evidence binding.
The two-document Google boundary matrix covers privacy, markers, revision conflicts and retained-evidence staleness.
